scenes.text: Hello there, little friend! I'm Sunny, and I am so excited to spend this time with you. Today, we're going on a super fun journey to learn all about confidence. Confidence is like having a little cheerleader inside you, saying, 'You can do it!' Are you ready to explore what confidence means and how we can find it in our everyday adventures? Let's get started and have an amazing time together!

Confidence is a magical feeling that helps us try new things and believe in ourselves. Imagine you want to climb a big playground slide. Confidence is the brave feeling that says, 'I can climb it all by myself!' Even if it seems a little scary at first, confidence helps us take those brave steps. It’s like a little sunshine inside us, making us feel all warm and powerful. Do you remember a time when you felt confident, like when you learned to tie your shoes or tried a new food? Those are wonderful moments!

Now, let's think about how we can build confidence, just like building a tower with blocks. Every time we try something new, we add another block. First, we can start small, like putting on our own socks. Then, we can try bigger things, like helping set the table. Each time we succeed, our confidence tower grows taller and taller. Remember, even if it wobbles, it’s okay! We can try again. Isn’t it exciting to see how high we can build our confidence?

Let’s practice some confidence-building right now! Can you give yourself a big hug and say, 'I am amazing!'? Wow, you did it! Every time you say positive things to yourself, you’re adding more sunshine to your heart. It might feel a bit funny at first, but the more we practice, the easier it gets. You’re doing such a great job! Remember, you can always cheer yourself on, just like a little cheerleader in your heart.

Remember when we talked about trying new things? Let’s think about a new adventure we can try together. How about learning a new dance move? Dancing is a fun way to feel confident because we can move our bodies in any way we like. Let’s stand up and shake our arms like we’re trees in the wind. Now, let’s stomp our feet like we’re big, strong elephants. Dancing is all about having fun and feeling good inside. Did you feel your confidence growing as you danced?

Now that we've danced, let's talk about something else that makes us feel confident. Can you think of a time when you helped someone, like a friend or a family member? Helping others is a wonderful way to build confidence. It makes us feel strong and proud because we're doing something kind. Maybe you helped by sharing your toys or by giving a big hug. Those are amazing things to do! Helping others not only makes them happy, but it also makes our confidence grow.

Let's learn a special confidence exercise. It’s called 'The Brave Breath.' First, let’s sit comfortably and take a deep breath in, like we’re smelling a beautiful flower. Now, slowly breathe out, like we’re blowing out a birthday candle. Let’s do it again—breathe in, and breathe out. Doesn’t that feel calming? Whenever you feel a little nervous or unsure, you can do 'The Brave Breath' to help your confidence shine bright.

You’re doing so well! Remember, confidence is something we can practice every day. It’s like brushing our teeth or tying our shoes. The more we do it, the better we get. And guess what? You’re already amazing at it! Every time you try something new or help someone, your confidence grows. You are like a little sunshine, bright and full of possibilities. Keep shining and trying new things, and you’ll discover just how wonderful you are.

Can you think of something you want to try that takes a little bit of confidence? Maybe it’s riding a bike without training wheels, or drawing a picture for someone special. What new adventure are you excited to try? Remember, it’s okay if it feels a little tricky at first. Confidence is like a muscle that gets stronger every time we use it. I’m so curious to hear about your new confidence adventure!

Now, let's imagine we’re brave explorers on a confidence quest. Our mission is to find three things we love about ourselves. It could be how kind we are, how well we can sing, or how fast we can run. These are our special powers that make us unique. What do you love about yourself? Remember, these special powers help our confidence grow. You’re a star, and there’s no one else quite like you!

Let’s practice sharing our confidence with others. Next time you see a friend, try giving them a compliment. You could say, 'I like your drawing!' or 'You’re really good at running!' Compliments are like little bits of sunshine we can share. When we give compliments, we help others feel confident too. Isn’t it wonderful to spread happiness and see our friends smile? Let’s make it a fun challenge to give a compliment every day!

You are doing amazing, little friend! Remember, confidence is about believing in yourself and knowing you can do great things. Even when things are a bit hard, you can always try again. You’re like a little sunbeam, full of light and energy. Keep practicing your confidence, and you’ll see just how bright you can shine. I believe in you, and I know you can do anything you set your mind to!

We've talked a lot about confidence today, haven’t we? Now, let’s think about our favorite part. Was it dancing, giving compliments, or maybe 'The Brave Breath'? Each of these helps us feel strong and brave. It’s important to remember that confidence is like a friend who is always with us. Whenever you need a little boost, just remember all the things we talked about and practiced today. You’ve got this!

Before we say goodbye, I have one more question. What is one thing you’re going to try today to build your confidence? Maybe it’s saying 'hello' to someone new or trying a new game. Whatever it is, I know you’ll do an amazing job. Confidence is about trying and learning, and you’re already so good at it. I’m excited to hear all about your adventures next time!

Thank you for spending this wonderful time with me, my little friend. Remember, confidence is your special power, and it’s always with you. Keep practicing, keep shining, and keep being you. I’m so proud of you and all the amazing things you’re going to do. Until next time, keep smiling and spreading your sunshine everywhere you go. Goodbye, and have a fantastic day!
